summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of redemption and cancellation of listing for two series of notes: Series 42 Notes (HK$1.5 billion, 1.55% due 2027) and Series 52 Notes (EUR 2 billion, 3.019% Fixed to Floating Rate due 2027). The issuer will redeem all outstanding notes at par (HK$1,000,000 per Calculation Amount and EUR 1,000 per Calculation Amount, respectively) on 3 June 2026 and 15 June 2026, plus accrued interest. The listings on the London Stock Exchange will be cancelled shortly after. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation.
